what: Create publication-ready PCA, t-SNE, or UMAP plots — ggpca
title: Create publication-ready PCA, t-SNE, or UMAP plots — ggpca
text: function generates dimensionality reduction plots (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP) options custom labels, titles, density plots, faceting. allows users visualize high-dimensional data using various dimensionality reduction techniques.

title: Create publication-ready PCA, t-SNE, or UMAP plots — ggpca
code: ggpca(   data,   metadata_cols,   mode = c("pca", "tsne", "umap"),   scale = TRUE,   x_pc = "PC1",   y_pc = "PC2",   color_var = NULL,   ellipse = TRUE,   ellipse_level = 0.9,   ellipse_type = "norm",   ellipse_alpha = 0.9,   point_size = 3,   point_alpha = 0.6,   facet_var = NULL,   tsne_perplexity = 30,   umap_n_neighbors = 15,   density_plot = "none",   color_palette = "Set1",   xlab = NULL,   ylab = NULL,   title = NULL,   subtitle = NULL,   caption = NULL )

title: Create publication-ready PCA, t-SNE, or UMAP plots — ggpca
text: data data frame containing data plotted. Must include feature columns (numeric) metadata columns (categorical). metadata_cols character vector column names numeric vector column indices metadata columns. columns used grouping faceting. mode dimensionality reduction method use. One "pca" (Principal Component Analysis), "tsne" (t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding), "umap" (Uniform Manifold Approximation Projection). scale Logical indicating whether scale features (default: TRUE PCA). used "tsne" "umap". x_pc Name principal component dimension plot x-axis (default: "PC1" PCA). y_pc Name principal component dimension plot y-axis (default: "PC2" PCA). color_var (Optional) Name column used color points plot. NULL, color applied. Supports discrete continuous variables. Default: NULL. ellipse Logical indicating whether add confidence ellipses groups (supported PCA color_var discrete; default: TRUE). ellipse_level Confidence level ellipses (default: 0.9). ellipse_type Type ellipse plot, e.g., "norm" normal distribution (default: "norm"). ellipse_alpha Transparency level ellipses, 0 fully transparent 1 fully opaque (default: 0.9). point_size Size points plot (default: 3). point_alpha Transparency level points, 0 fully transparent 1 fully opaque (default: 0.6). facet_var Formula faceting plot (e.g., Category ~ .), allowing users split plot different groups. tsne_perplexity Perplexity parameter t-SNE, balances local global aspects data (default: 30). umap_n_neighbors Number neighbors UMAP, determines local structure (default: 15). density_plot Controls whether add density plots x, y, axes. Accepts one "none", "x", "y", "" (default: "none"). color_palette Name color palette (used discrete variables) use plot. Supports "Set1", "Set2", etc. RColorBrewer (default: "Set1"). xlab Custom x-axis label (default: NULL, auto-generated based data). ylab Custom y-axis label (default: NULL, auto-generated based data). title Plot title (default: NULL). subtitle Plot subtitle (default: NULL). caption Plot caption (default: NULL).

title: Create publication-ready PCA, t-SNE, or UMAP plots — ggpca
